tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page ground on every screen. A warm paper white in light, a warm near-black in dark; never pure white or black.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on `canvas`: dialogs, popovers and cards. Pair with `shadow-overlay` in light.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: hover on rows and buttons, a code or prompt block, a table's header row.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules between table rows and sections. Decorative, so it carries no contrast duty; never a control border.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, outlined buttons and segmented controls. At least 3:1 on `canvas`, `panel` and `tile`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `canvas`, `panel` and `tile`; the fill of the primary button (one colour for act).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `ink` fill: the primary button and the selected segment.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text: times, counts, hints, captions and labels. Never faded further.

tokens.name: error-ink
tokens.usage: Errors the console itself hit (a failed read, a refused action), always with the circle-alert icon and words.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: a solid 2px outline at 2px offset on every interactive element.

tokens.name: pen
tokens.usage: OK, and nothing else: the status mark of a healthy check (Claude reachable, a task's last run succeeded), always beside words. Never links, buttons or decoration.

tokens.name: pen-partial
tokens.usage: Degraded, and nothing else: the status mark of a check that works with a warning, always beside words. In light it is 1.5–1.9:1 on the page, so it is only ever a filled mark, never text, and the words carry the meaning.

tokens.name: pen-missed
tokens.usage: Failing, and nothing else: the status mark of a failing check, always beside words. A status, not a message: the console's own errors use `error-ink`.

tokens.name: caution-ink
tokens.usage: A caution in words, such as a paused task that runs at once when resumed. Never for errors.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a modal dialog, at 40% opacity. Only behind dialogs.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The page's name, once per screen. Below 640px wide, 36/40.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Section titles: Overview, Tasks, Groups, Permissions, Problems.

styles.name: body-large
styles.sample: Claude is answering. Last success two minutes ago.
styles.usage: The single summary line under a section title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Daily documentation summary, every day at 07:00
styles.usage: All running text, inputs, buttons and table cells.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Supporting lines in `ink-secondary`: times, counts, hints, in sentence case.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, table headers and chips. Never uppercase or letter-spaced.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: Summarise yesterday's changes to the docs.
styles.usage: A prompt or other text someone wrote, quoted as written, in italic.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap; between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a field and its message; between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside buttons and inputs; table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Side gutter on phones; gap between stacked form parts.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between a section title and its table.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Side gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Space above the footer and below the last section.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Fields, tiles and chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, icon buttons and segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels: dialogs, popovers, cards.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Round things: the Switch track and thumb, status dots.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Overlays only: dialogs and the popover. In dark the `panel` colour does the lifting.
